intro: Cambodia is a constitutional monarchy dominated by one party.

chapters.title: How it works
text: King Norodom Sihamoni is head of state. The Cambodian People's Party has ruled since 1979; Hun Sen was prime minister for 38 years, and his son Hun Manet took over in 2023. Opposition parties have been banned.

chapters.title: Border tensions
text: In 2025 a border dispute with Thailand led to deadly clashes before a ceasefire.

keyTerms.meaning: A monarch reigns under a constitution.
